name: Moovicut
description: Free deterministic storyboard planning. No API key, no account, and no stored premises. Moovicut does not render video. The default board is 5 scenes of 3 seconds (15s). Pass shots, duration, a scenes array, a scenario, or input prose for a custom board.

tools.name: plan_storyboard
tools.description: Plan a storyboard. Default 5 scenes × 3s. Optional scenes, scenario, input prose, or regenerateShot. Returns a compact payload and a /studio# link. Warnings are included only when a shot looks risky.

tools.name: export_prompts
tools.description: Return shot prompts for a premise or an existing board.
